meta.title: SCIM User Provisioning with SSO Configuration correctly configured (DEP-005)
gaps: Exercise SCIM User Provisioning and verify it works as configured
Verify that no orphaned provisioned accounts or other stated failure impact occurs
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure SSO Configuration correctly; Configure SCIM User Provisioning; Exercise SCIM User Provisioning and verify it works as configured; Verify that no orphaned provisioned accounts or other stated failure impact occurs

args.need: configure SSO and SCIM User Provisioning, then exercise provisioning to verify it works without creating orphaned accounts or the dependency failure impact

steps.note: No catalog step can configure or exercise SCIM/SSO provisioning or observe account provisioning outcomes.
Checks that the current screen has no visible application errors after the tester's provisioning workflow, but does not verify SCIM behavior itself.
